headline: Marshall extends its season into late November
dek: Following a draw at Michigan State, Marshall hosts Wake Forest with twelve wins and three losses across all matches, having scored 42 goals and allowed 24. Marshall also drew five times and finished level at the top of the Sun Belt table, while co-leader West Virginia lost at home to Washington.
displaced_by: West Virginia lost to Washington, invalidating the standing nine-goal and two-loss figures.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Goals scored do not sort this conference: Old Dominion has scored 39 and won ten, yet all six of its defeats came against Sun Belt sides.

wire.line: Sun Belt sides have won 44, drawn seventeen, and lost twenty outside the conference, scoring 151 goals and conceding 92.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: West Virginia's home match with Akron is past its date with no result published, and it is the only Sun Belt match in that state.

findings.text: Drew Hansen has scored twelve of UCF's 35 goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Erik Jaspers has made 59 saves for James Madison, a save percentage of .787.

findings.text: West Virginia has won thirteen matches, more than any other Sun Belt program.

last_match.line: West Virginia entered unbeaten at home all season; its previous defeats came away at Charlotte and Old Dominion.

next_match.line: Marshall's lone defeat outside the Sun Belt came at home to Utah Valley.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
